##### Project general facts

Exotica by Al Marina rises as an eighteen‑story architectural gem crafted by Al Marina, offering eighty‑eight residential units across one‑ and two‑bedroom configurations. The façade blends contemporary sleek lines with timeless details, showcasing modern finishes and exquisite architectural accents that command visual interest. Inside, spacious living areas, stylish kitchens equipped with modern appliances, and panoramic views frame a refined ambience for residents.

The development delivers a suite of lifestyle‑enhancing facilities, including a fully equipped gym, an inviting swimming pool, thoughtfully designed play areas for children, and communal spaces that foster social interaction among neighbours. These amenities are arranged to encourage a sense of community while providing private moments of relaxation. Residents can therefore enjoy a balanced routine of fitness, recreation, and gathering within their own building.

Modern finishing with high‑quality materials defines the interior palette, complemented by a luxury smart home system that integrates seamlessly with Alexa, Google Home and Siri. The kitchen adopts a modular layout furnished with modern branded appliances, ensuring both functionality and contemporary style. No additional furnishing is supplied, allowing occupants to personalize their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle sits at the heart of Dubai, encircled by tree‑lined avenues that weave through the community. The circular layout creates a sense of continuity and easy navigation for residents. Its central position grants swift access to major arterial roads that connect the neighbourhood to the wider city.

The neighbourhood is dotted with tranquil parks that provide green relief amid the urban fabric. Families benefit from nearby schools that are integrated into the community plan. Retail enthusiasts enjoy several shopping centres positioned within short walking distance.

Recreational facilities, including sports courts and cycling paths, encourage an active lifestyle. The blend of spacious villas and contemporary apartments fosters a balanced environment for diverse households. Overall, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers a harmonious mix of modern convenience and natural serenity.
